evidence_notes: Diagnosed 2 years ago, likely had it longer. Signs in college attributed to ADHD meds and poor diet. Symptoms worsened post-graduation. Constant urgency, cramping, blood. First GI visit after a bad week. Colonoscopy showed inflammation. Treatments: mesalamine suppositories/oral (minimal help), prednisone (increased anxiety, panic attack, nearly lost job). Azathioprine started 6 months ago (40% help). Doctor wants biologics, but patient is terrified due to immunocompromise, stress, lack of sleep, and needle phobia triggering anxiety. Parents dismissive. Dating difficult ('too much work'). Architecture requires site visits, and portapotties are a nightmare. Considering leaving profession due to loans and need for income. Next appointment in two weeks, likely to agree to biologics despite fear. Anxiety and Crohn's feed each other. Therapist helping, but process is slow.
